Neither lift test confirms retention. Reopen and correct toward the objects seen beyond the fingertips: move left forward/right onto the cup and right outward/down onto the basket wall, then pinch.
Reopen and move the left grasp center to the cup's right-shifted body. Reach the basket's near wall from the side with a flatter right wrist and a rearward path to limit extension.
Clear the cup vertically to avoid pushing it sideways before the next approach. The basket is forward of the right fingertips, so correct forward at low height, then pinch its rim.

Close both jaws at the observed poses without further reaching, then make a short upward withdrawal to check actual retention and recover extension margin.
